Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Hello. I know the value of a dishwasher better than anyone, but it was always inconvenient because it was small. As expected, bigger is better. It seats 12 people, so it really holds a lot of space. Sentence (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Hello. The technician came yesterday to install the MyDea 12-seater dishwasher :). On the day of installation, I received a call and sent photos and dimensions of the dishwasher location. They said they would remove it and install it. The installation took over 2 hours and 30 minutes because the size of my house was a bit awkward, requiring me to remove both sinks. Since I'm planning on installing a built-in sink, I was planning on removing one of the existing sinks, but one wasn't enough. So I also removed the slide-out sink cabinet that used to hold seasoning containers and installed it. As you can see in the photo, there was a gap, so I filled it in somehow. You can see a little of the top. Other than that, I'm completely satisfied. I'll be reinforcing it later. First, I saw it in person. It's incredibly large, probably because it's designed for 12 people. I had a dishwasher before, but it was so small that I didn't use it built-in, which made me appreciate the value of a dishwasher. I know this better than anyone, but it was always inconvenient because it was small. As expected, bigger is better. It's a 12-person dishwasher, so it really holds a lot. It can fit a rice cooker and a large pot or frying pan just fine. I tested it on standard mode yesterday and it really did a good job of cleaning. And it's really quiet. The one I used before was so loud that it was uncomfortable. The Mydia 12-person dishwasher is really quiet. I can't even tell if it's working because it's so quiet, right? ^^. It really washes well, and I can just throw it in the solid detergent and fill it with rinse aid. I'm so happy to be free from the hassle of washing dishes. My life can be divided into before and after the dishwasher. It's so convenient that I can't do household chores without it. The white color doesn't spoil the interior and is so pretty. It also comes with a cutlery basket, and you can put cutlery on the top and bottom, and on the very top. I just put my cutlery in there. It's really spacious and big, so I'm completely satisfied with this dishwasher. It's so nice to be free from the burden of washing dishes. I don't think I'll have to worry about having guests over. I highly recommend the Mydia 12-person dishwasher, which has excellent cleaning power and dries quickly.

Reason for purchase: I've been married for a year now! Soon after, a new baby arrived, and with our growing family, the number of dishes has increased. I waited 2-3 days after installation to order dishwasher-specific detergent, and I've been using it for about two weeks now, and I am relatively satisfied. Sentence (English): Bought this DW to replace an LG that got destroyed in a flood.
Comments (English): [ Quiet Dishwasher!  ] || ---------------- || Bought this DW to replace an LG that got destroyed in a flood. Would have gotten the same LG DW but wasn't in stock at the time. So far this dishwasher has been satisfactory. The installer left a few pages of information but nothing about what cycle to use when. I used the short cycle which kinda washed my dishes but they were soaking wet. Thinking something was wrong with the unit, I called the repairman. He instructed me that the short cycle does not use heat and that is why my dishes were wet. He told me to use the normal cycle which cleared up the problem. On another note, the third rack does not hold my utensils very well, so I don't use it. I use the basket on the lower rack for my utensils. The normal cycle takes over 3 hours to complete but the repairman assured me it only uses 7 gallons of water and is very energy efficient. Would have been nice to read in the instructions those things but, whatever. The DW is quiet so that is good

Even though I'm a family of 2, I chose a 14-person one because whether I'm a family of 3 or 4, the only difference is the dishes and spoons, but everyone eats the same way. Sentence (English): I chose the dishwasher based on low noise (42dB) and because of the Bosch quality, it has the ability to save your own washing program settings, which you can then always use, or you can set a program that is automatically selected after switching on.
Comments (English): [ Built-in dishwasher BOSCH SMV4ECX28E ] || ---------------- || I chose the dishwasher based on low noise (42dB) and because of the Bosch quality, it has the ability to save your own washing program settings, which you can then always use, or you can set a program that is automatically selected after switching on. The HomeConnect application has a lot of useful information and settings that you don't need to look for in the manual after a while. Of the minuses, I miss the remaining time information projected onto the floor (only a red light is on during operation), the previous dishwasher had it, I was used to it. But you can see it in the application. I also have a problem with building it into an IKEA kitchen unit (if I use the original door trim, I can't open the dishwasher all the way down), it will require adjusting the trim, or using a "hinge" system.
Comments (Original): [ Vstavaná umývačka BOSCH SMV4ECX28E ] || ---------------- || Umývačku som vyberal na základe nízkej hlučnosti(42dB) a kvôli kvalite Bosch, má možnosť si uložiť vlastné nastavenia umývacieho programu, ktorý potom človek stále používa, príp. si vie nastaviť program, ktorý je automaticky navolený po zapnutí. V aplikácii HomeConnect je veľa užitočných informácií a nastavení, ktoré netreba po nejakej dobe hľadať v návode. Z mínusov mi chýba údaj o zostávajúcom čase premietajúci sa na zem(počas chodu svieti iba červené svetlo), predchádzajúca umývačka to mala, bol som na to zvyknutý. Ale dá sa to pozrieť v aplikácii. Tiež mám problém so zabudovaním do kuchynskej linky IKEA(ak použijem pôvodné obloženie dvierok, neviem umývačku otvoriť úplne dole), bude to chcieť úpraviť obloženie, prípadne použiť 'pántový' systém.

Sentence (English): I have been, frankly, ASTONISHED by the performance of this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Extremely impressive performance ] || ---------------- || I have been, frankly, ASTONISHED by the performance of this dishwasher. We have - as recommended - filled it with all sorts of dirty dishes and pans, none of which have been pre-rinsed. We have used dishwasher pods, but, in an addition to what is recommended in the manual, put a very small amount of dishwasher powder at the bottom of the door so that the pre-rinse cycle includes a little detergent. The end results are far superior to our previous dishwasher. I have never seen my stainless fry pans and pressure cooker pans so clean and shiny before - probably not even when new. The zeolith "Crystal Dry" is also a major improvement over my prior dishwasher - while not all plastic items are necessarily perfectly dry, the majority are, unlike all prior dishwashers that I have owned.

Sentence (English): I've had this dishwasher for a month and a half, and the truth is that it works impeccably.
Comments (English): [ Quiet, very capable, modular interior. ] || ---------------- || I've had this dishwasher for a month and a half, and the truth is that it works impeccably. Sentence (English): Bought this to replace an 8 year old Whirlpool that started to leak.
Comments (English): [ Turbo wash is ridiculously loud, solid performance ] || ---------------- || Bought this to replace an 8 year old Whirlpool that started to leak. As a cheap replacement with solid Consumer Reports ratings, I took a chance on this. So far, after the third wash the only major disappointment is the extreme noise of the Turbo Wash setting. With a small kitchen and open plan the turbo wash is a not an option. The normal setting is reasonably quiet even with nothing in the tub. I should also point out that the drain/fill pump on this is extremely powerful and therefore it makes a lot of noise when draining/filling if you are in close quarters, it will be intrusive. With those caveats, the wash and dry performance is actually very good, better than the Whirlpool which was slightly more expensive, but this machine is brand new. If it lasts 5-8 years with no repairs, I'll consider it a good purchase. However, even if it needs a minor repair during that time, I will probably just replace it because the low cost of the machine is probably not worth fixing. Note that this is supposed to a have leak sensor with auto shut off. The only question for me now is durability. I'm pleased with overall performance and would cautiously recommend. You should opt for a more expensive/lower DB machine if noise is a concern.

Sentence (English): I purchased this dishwasher after a great experience with a 100-series dishwasher from about 2020.
Comments (English): [ great performance but needlessly app-ified ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher after a great experience with a 100-series dishwasher from about 2020. I was especially looking forward to the AutoAir feature which automatically opens the door at the end of a cycle to help finish drying.The performance of the dishwasher has largely delivered and is in line with my previous experience. It cleans reliably and quietly and the racks are flexible enough to accommodate most situations. However, in some ways it's a significant downgrade from my older 100-series.For starters, the delay start feature is now buried in an app. Why a dishwasher needs an app, I'm still not sure I understand. Since I have to be there to load the dishes and detergent, what's the point of remote start? The only reason I use it at all is as a stand-in for delay start, which I did by:- setting up a Google Home automation to start at a specified time, and- setting the remote control level in the app to manualWhen you want to delay start, press the remote start button instead and close the door. You need to do this anytime you open the door too. If you accidently hit run, then you'll need to reset the dishwasher and start over.The app does let you specify a window which the dishwasher runs. This would solve the delay start problem, but unfortunately it only works if you use the app to start the cycle. If you use the controls on the dishwasher, it ignores the app settings and starts the cycle immediately. The stemware holders are also a downgrade from the previous generation rack. The older holder flipped down and locked in place to hold stemware. These new holders flip up, and so if you're like me and load the dishwasher throughout the day, this means you may have to unload the sides to access the holder after having wine with dinner.Lastly, I hate the touch controls. The dishwasher is to the right of my sink, and I sometimes graze the power button as I'm closing it. If you power it on without starting a cycle, then it beeps very loudly at you. The power button on the last generation worked just fine, this was another needless change.These annoyances are to the point that I'm shopping for a previous generation 500 or 800 series washer. Until Bosch fixes these issues, I can't recommend them anymore.

Sentence (English): I just bought my first dishwasher and I chose a BOSCH dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ My first dishwasher, and I chose BOSCH. ] || ---------------- || I just bought my first dishwasher and I chose a BOSCH dishwasher. After my first loads of dishes, I'm very happy with the results. Although we're currently two users and this dishwasher is recommended for 3 or 4, I decided to take a risk and choose one with a third cutlery tray. During the week, we use our Tupperware a lot, and they quickly fill up a tray. Plus, its white design is elegant and fits perfectly into any kitchen. Despite having a D energy efficiency rating, its consumption is quite reasonable thanks to water and energy optimization technologies. It leaves dishes spotless, even with tough residue. I still have to learn how to get the most out of the Home Connect feature, which allows you to control the dishwasher from your phone. It also has automatic programs that adjust the amount of water and temperature based on how dirty the dishwasher is. It's quite quiet, which is a plus if you're looking for comfort at home without annoying noises. In short, I recently bought a house and I'm trying to equip it with Bosch appliances. I already have a washing machine, now a dishwasher, and who knows, maybe an oven or microwave will be next! Definitely a brand I trust.
Comments (Original): [ Mi primer Lavavajillas, y he elegido a BOSCH. ] || ---------------- || Acabo de adquirir mi primer lavavajillas y he elegido BOSCH, y tras realizar mis primeros lavados, estoy muy contento con el resultado.Aunque por ahora somos dos usuarios y este lavavajillas está recomendado para 3 o 4, quise arriesgarme y elegir uno con una tercera bandeja para cubiertos, entre semana usamos mucho los tupperware, y se ocupan rápidamente una bandeja. Además, su diseño en color blanco es elegante y se integra perfectamente en cualquier cocina.A pesar de tener una eficiencia energética D, su consumo es bastante razonable gracias a las tecnologías de optimización del agua y la energía. Deja los platos impecables, incluso con restos difíciles.Todavía tengo que aprender a sacar el máximo partido con la función Home Connect, que permite controlar el lavavajillas desde el móvil. También cuenta con programas automáticos que ajustan la cantidad de agua y temperatura según la suciedad. Es bastante silencioso, lo cual es un punto a favor si buscas comodidad en casa sin ruidos molestos.En definitiva, recientemente he comprado una casa y estoy intentando equiparla toda con electrodomésticos Bosch. Ya tengo una lavadora, ahora el lavavajillas, y quién sabe, ¡quizás lo siguiente sea un horno o microondas! Sin duda, una marca en la que confío.

Sentence (English): It's been about a week since I've used the Bespoke countertop dishwasher for 6 people, and I'm more satisfied than I expected.
Comments (English): [ A stylish, quiet, and powerful dishwasher ] || ---------------- || It's been about a week since I've used the Bespoke countertop dishwasher for 6 people, and I'm more satisfied than I expected. First of all, the design is really stylish. The clean color and design give it a luxurious feel at first glance. The size is also not burdensome, which is nice. What I was most satisfied with while using it is that it makes almost no noise. It's quiet enough that it doesn't disturb me at all while watching TV or talking in the living room when the dishwasher is running. I especially like it because I don't have to worry about using it late at night. The cleaning power is also excellent. It washes even greasy frying pans and rice bowls cleanly. At first, I was worried that the cleaning power would be weak because of its small size, but I didn't have to worry at all. In particular, when using the strong cleaning mode, it was much cleaner than washing dishes by hand, so I'm very satisfied. Overall, it exceeded my expectations in terms of design, noise, and cleaning power, and I highly recommend it for 2-3 person households or small families.
Comments (Original): [ 세련되고 소음이 적으며 세척력이 만족스러운 식기세척기 ] || ---------------- || 비스포크 카운터탑 식기세척기 6인용을 사용한 1주 정도 되었는데, 기대 이상으로 만족스럽습니다.  우선 디자인이 정말 세련됐어요. 깔끔한 색상과 디자인 덕분에 한눈에 봐도 고급스러운 느낌이 납니다. 크기도 부담스럽지 않아서 좋았여요.  사용하면서 가장 만족했던 점은 소음이 거의 없다는 점이에요. 식기세척기를 돌릴 때 거실에서 TV를 보거나 대화를 나누는 데 전혀 방해가 되지 않을 정도로 조용합니다. 특히 밤늦게 사용해도 걱정이 없어서 너무 좋아요.  세척력도 훌륭합니다. 기름기 많은 프라이팬이나 밥그릇도 깨끗하게 세척됩니다. 처음에는 작은 크기 때문에 세척력이 약할까 걱정했지만, 그런 우려는 전혀 필요 없었어요. 특히 강력 세척 모드를 사용하면 손 설거지보다 훨씬 깔끔하게 닦여서 만족도가 높습니다.  전반적으로 디자인, 소음, 세척력 모든 면에서 기대 이상이었고, 2~3인 가구나 작은 가족에게 강력 추천할 만한 제품입니다.

Sentence (English): This is a genuine review based on using it every day for several months!
Comments (English): This is a genuine review based on using it every day for several months! Reason for purchase: When I only had one baby, I just kept doing the dishes by hand thinking it was fine. However, as my second child started eating more, I seriously debated buying a dishwasher hundreds of times. As they went from baby food to full meals, snacks, and all sorts of other things, I felt like it was the right time to buy one. Two babies need rice bowls, snack bowls, cutlery, daycare trays, water bottles, and so on, plus my husband's and my bowls for rice, soup, and side dishes. I finally bought one and am using it now, and I wish I had bought it sooner. I am extremely satisfied with it! User review: Although it is a 6-person capacity model, the interior is spacious and holds a huge amount! I saw it in person at the supermarket, and even though it is a 6-person model, it was quite large. Since my building is an older structure, I wasn't even considering a built-in unit. I chose this one because I thought it would be more convenient to have it placed on a shelf and easy to access, and the size was perfect! As I used it more, I got the hang of it. If you pack everything neatly, most rice bowls, soup bowls, side dish bowls, snack bowls, cutlery, and more fit inside! Since I believe it's better to hand-wash pots and pans even if there is space because of the non-stick coating, I was satisfied with the size. Simple operation! It's very convenient. The buttons are intuitive and easy to see right away! It was so easy since you just have to press them. I usually use the standard setting by simply pressing the power button. When I press the start button, it automatically keeps draining water and rinsing, so I really understand why people call it "Dishwasher Auntie." It's super convenient. The automatic door opening feature was sufficient even without the hot air drying function. I actually debated a lot between this and the hot air drying model, but I heard the electricity bill is insane because the dishwasher has to run continuously for that purpose. Two babies need rice bowls, snack bowls, cutlery, daycare trays, water bottles, and so on, plus my husband's and my bowls for rice, soup, and side dishes. User review: Although it is a 6-person capacity model, the interior is spacious and holds a huge amount! I actually debated a lot between this and the hot air drying model, but I heard the electricity bill is insane because the dishwasher has to run continuously for that purpose. However, the automatic door opening feature made it fine! It usually finishes before I go to bed, so once it's done, I leave the door wide open while I sleep! Comments (English): [ great performance but needlessly app-ified ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher after a great experience with a 100-series dishwasher from about 2020. I was especially looking forward to the AutoAir feature which automatically opens the door at the end of a cycle to help finish drying. The performance of the dishwasher has largely delivered and is in line with my previous experience. It cleans reliably and quietly and the racks are flexible enough to accommodate most situations. However, in some ways it's a significant downgrade from my older 100-series. For starters, the delay start feature is now buried in an app. Why a dishwasher needs an app, I'm still not sure I understand. Since I have to be there to load the dishes and detergent, what's the point of remote start? The only reason I use it at all is as a stand-in for delay start, which I did by:. - setting up a Google Home automation to start at a specified time, and. - setting the remote control level in the app to manual. When you want to delay start, press the remote start button instead and close the door. You need to do this anytime you open the door too. If you accidently hit run, then you'll need to reset the dishwasher and start over. The app does let you specify a window which the dishwasher runs. This would solve the delay start problem, but unfortunately it only works if you use the app to start the cycle. If you use the controls on the dishwasher, it ignores the app settings and starts the cycle immediately. The stemware holders are also a downgrade from the previous generation rack. The older holder flipped down and locked in place to hold stemware. These new holders flip up, and so if you're like me and load the dishwasher throughout the day, this means you may have to unload the sides to access the holder after having wine with dinner. Lastly, I hate the touch controls. The dishwasher is to the right of my sink, and I sometimes graze the power button as I'm closing it. If you power it on without starting a cycle, then it beeps very loudly at you. The power button on the last generation worked just fine, this was another needless change. These annoyances are to the point that I'm shopping for a previous generation 500 or 800 series washer. Until Bosch fixes these issues, I can't recommend them anymore.

However, in some ways it's a significant downgrade from my older 100-series. For starters, the delay start feature is now buried in an app. Why a dishwasher needs an app, I'm still not sure I understand. Since I have to be there to load the dishes and detergent, what's the point of remote start? If you accidently hit run, then you'll need to reset the dishwasher and start over. The app does let you specify a window which the dishwasher runs. This would solve the delay start problem, but unfortunately it only works if you use the app to start the cycle. If you use the controls on the dishwasher, it ignores the app settings and starts the cycle immediately. The stemware holders are also a downgrade from the previous generation rack. The older holder flipped down and locked in place to hold stemware. These new holders flip up, and so if you're like me and load the dishwasher throughout the day, this means you may have to unload the sides to access the holder after having wine with dinner. Lastly, I hate the touch controls. The dishwasher is to the right of my sink, and I sometimes graze the power button as I'm closing it. If you power it on without starting a cycle, then it beeps very loudly at you. The power button on the last generation worked just fine, this was another needless change. These annoyances are to the point that I'm shopping for a previous generation 500 or 800 series washer. Until Bosch fixes these issues, I can't recommend them anymore.

Sentence (English): I've had this dishwasher almost 3 years now, and I definitely recommend it.
Comments (English): [ So, far, I love it! ] || ---------------- || I've had this dishwasher almost 3 years now, and I definitely recommend it. The top rack fits more than any other top rack dishwasher I have seen. It cleans great and is REALLY quiet. I quit using the pro-dry setting, as the prolonged extra heat caused some of my glassware to get permanently cloudy, but dishes still get mostly dry on the normal cycle without the extra drying cycle. It could use more wine glass holder clips, as those come in handy. The movable tines on the middle rack are sometime a little wonky, though.The main thing is to figure out the best way to load YOUR dishes to fit well, and don't load it haphazardly. Also, get a licensed PLUMBER to install it, even if it is replacing another dishwasher. When we got ours, the commercial TRUCK DRIVERS were apparently contracted by Whirlpool to do the installation. BAD IDEA all around. They were clueless and should never have been allowed to install anything bigger than a toaster.

If I fill a clean glass with water, there will be a small amount of soap suds floating on the surface. If I rinse the glass, dry it, then fill it again- no suds. Plus the outside of the glass or dish will be slippery as soon as, the clean glass gets wet. This is true all my dishes. The machine may clean the food off the dishes, but it does not clean off the soap. I am also unhappy about the connectivity. Very very unhappy to have to rinse every dish and glass before use. What's the point? I should just wash them all by hand. I contacted Bosch by phone about this a few months back and the rep had no clue, no help, and little empathy.

Comments (English): [ The world is at ease. ] || ---------------- || - My own review - Seeing all the ladies who prepare and wash dishes every day, their elbows hurt, so I desperately felt the need for a dishwasher, so I bought it. After comparing several products on Coupang, I chose a product from a major Korean company. I was worried about Chinese brand dishwashers that don't require drilling, but I decided after reading reviews that say that even if you drill, there won't be many marks. I trusted Samsung and bought it, and two installers came. At first, I asked them to install it without drilling through the detergent hole in our sink, but they tried to reflect my request as much as possible, but the screw in the detergent hole wouldn't come off even when the man pulled it out with a tool, so I had no choice but to drill it. I was grateful that they tried to reflect my opinion and install it. They finished the drilling well without additional cost, and they explained and cleaned up well after installation. The no-brand dishwasher detergent is the most cost-effective and all-in-one, so I bought it and used the dishwasher, and it was a new world. It even cleans spoon stains well. If you stand the bowl upside down rather than completely upside down, you can clean the rice bowl well. I knew that the original dishwasher was better at cleaning grease, but maybe because it's a new dishwasher, it cleans rice balls and seasoning stains very well. I thought it would be small because it's a 6-person dishwasher, but the entire machine is bigger than I thought and takes up quite a bit of space. It's a single-story dishwasher, not a two-story one. Maybe that's why it feels like it takes up more space outside than inside. Still, it's a new world like this because all those plates and cups that I had worked so hard to wash are now clean and sterilized. My quality of life has changed since I bought the dishwasher. After using it once or twice a day for a month, I checked the maintenance fee and found that my electricity bill had increased by about 4,000 won compared to the previous month, but my water bill had actually decreased. In conclusion, I'm very satisfied!

I highly recommend this essential item that has made my kitchen life more luxurious!

I highly recommend this essential item that has made my kitchen life more luxurious!

For reference, I am a 3n-year-old woman, and I came back after taking a picture of it by myself. I set the water control pedal to automatic and kept getting an error when I turned on the dishwasher, so I thought about it and realized that if I keep using water with the pedal on, The water supply was cut off automatically, so I immediately changed it to manual and turned on the dishwasher, and it worked well. Comments (English): [ A family of 4, living a life with dinner for 6 people ] || ---------------- || Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE countertop dishwasher 6-person, DW30CB300CW0 (white) Purchase date: April 10 Purchase environment: Rented house (perforated), using Pox and Frog detergent alternately I am a 30-something housewife from a family of four with two children who hate washing dishes the most in the world. Ever since I was a little girl, I have always hated washing dishes the most. When I was a little girl living with my parents, I used to run away from it with every excuse, but now that I have been in charge of a household for 10 years, it is not something I can avoid. Since it is a rented house, a dishwasher for 8 or more people that requires construction was out of the question, so while looking around, I found a Samsung 6-person dishwasher at a low price and bought it. I hesitated a little about the perforation, but fortunately, with the permission of the owner, I perforated the corner and installed it. I have written down some simple tips below, so I think it would be good to refer to them when purchasing or using it. It is enough to cover the daily dishwashing of a family of four. Some people may be worried because the capacity is small, but it is not at all. When you actually receive it, you will be surprised by its size. We are a family of four, 1 office worker, 1 housewife, 1 elementary school student, and 1 kindergarten student. 3 people eat breakfast, 1 person lunch, and 4 people eat dinner. After dinner, I turn on all the dishes, plates, cups, spoons, and other cooking utensils at once and rest. Of course, if I cook a lot, I turn on twice. I have not used hot air, so I don't know, but I think it is not necessary. They say that it dries better if there is hot air drying, but if the price difference is that big, I think it is not necessary. If you open the dryer after a while and leave it wide open, it will be completely dry. If you think about cost-effectiveness, I think it is not necessary. If you time it right, you can buy it at a low price. Since it is a branded product, the price range is high, but if you time it right, you can buy it at a lower price. In particular, Coupang was the cheapest, and I bought it for the mid-400,000 won price with a card discount. It goes up and down a lot, so watch it carefully and buy it when you find a price range you can compromise on. The benefits change every hour or two even within a day. Unlike built-ins, I don't have to bend over, which is great. This is an advantage in my opinion. With built-ins, you have to keep bending to the side to lift and lower them, but with a 6-person bed, you can stand upright and move it, which is so great. I think it's really the best advantage. Installation depends on the technician. The installation method and attention to detail will vary slightly depending on the technician. The technician who came to my house was not so great. ^^ While reading reviews, I hope you take a close look at how other houses were installed, and then think about how to install it in your house. When the technicians come, tell me the location of the sticker attachment, the length of the drain, and other necessary information. Be sure to do a pre-wash. Pre-washing is not something fancy. It's better to put water in the dishwasher and soak the dishes after eating, then rinse off any food stuck on them with water before putting them in the dishwasher. Anyway, if there's food left, it will remain in the dishwasher filter later, and since the water flow is weaker than that of a dishwasher for 10 or more people, it won't do a miracle like a YouTuber. The egg stains on the pot where I ate ramen didn't come off. So I recommend doing a pre-wash and running it with a mild detergent. Sentence (English): We purchased this unit after the Bosch we had for almost a decade finally ran its course.
Comments (English): [ Buyer beware - pump problems ] || ---------------- || We purchased this unit after the Bosch we had for almost a decade finally ran its course. We went with kitchen aid because we wanted to match the other appliances we have. We liked the appearance along with the third rack and everything seemed to be fine for the first 11 months. Then recently we discovered that after running a cycle none of the dishes had been cleaned. Thinking this was odd we tried to run the washer again only to have it start making a loud buzzing noise from underneath followed by a strong burning smell. Immediately disconnected power and pulled the washer out to find that the pump was excessively hot and to the point that it couldn't be touched. Really glad we were home at that time as this very well could have set the house on fire if it were unattended. Pulled the sump and circulation pump out the next day after it had cooled down and you can smell the burning odor in the pump. Contacted customer service about getting a new pump and was told fixing it myself would void the warranty. Not having the time to wait for a service appointment only to have a tech tell us what we already knew and then having to wait for them to get parts we found a replacement at a local supplier and fixed it the same day. Unfortunately we didn't see the reviews for this product as we probably wouldn't have purchased it if we had. Trying to give kitchen aid the benefit of the doubt thinking we might have had a lemon. After reading many of the reviews it's hard to believe that is true as the failing pumps appear to be a common problem with these washers. Would not recommend this dishwasher and would advise anyone considering purchasing one to do their research as there are probably better options at this price point. One plus is that this washer was actually fairly easy to work on so if you find yourself outside of the warranty window and are mechanically inclined you should be able to fix it with the help of a YouTube video or two. Just be ready to shell out about 300 bucks for parts.

Sentence (English): Here's a review after one month of use.
Comments (English): [ This is a review after using it for a month. 1. First, it is really important to roughly clean up any food stuck on the dishes and soak them in water. If you don't do this, it won't be completely removed even after washing the dishes. 2. I'm a larva. ] || ---------------- || Here's a review after one month of use. 1. First, it's really important to roughly clean up any food particles on the dishes and soak them in water. If you don't do this, they won't be completely removed, even after being washed in the dishwasher. 2. I do pre-wash, but it's not a particularly laborious process. I just rinse the already-soaked dishes in clean water and put them back in. 3. It may be a matter of personal preference, but I'm impatient, so I use rapid mode. If you've done steps 1 and 2 well, rapid mode is sufficient. It removes most grease well. It only takes 5 minutes to clean the dishes, and after about 30 minutes of washing, you can hear the fan running, which is incredibly satisfying. 4. I air-dry. The hot air drying time (90 minutes) is too long. Even in rapid mode, the dishwasher uses hot water by default, so air-drying dries quickly. After rapid mode, the fan automatically turns on, but you can simply press the power button to stop it and leave the door open. 5. The spoon holder on the two-tier tray is really uncomfortable to use. This is something I hope Minix will improve. For now, I'm using a perforated stainless steel spoon holder from DaXso, and it's perfect. I recommend it. I got rid of the two-tier tray and am using more space. Most medium-sized pots fit. 6. I'm using half the Minix detergent. Unless you have dishes crammed in like in the commercial, this is enough. At first, I was annoyed by the white water stains left after washing the dishes, but after reducing the amount of detergent I used, there were hardly any water stains. My quality of life has really changed since I bought the Minix dishwasher. In the past, just thinking about washing dishes would stress me out and make my fingers hurt, but these days, I'm really happy. Thank you for making such a great product.

Sentence (English): It only takes 5 minutes to clean the dishes, and after about 30 minutes of washing, you can hear the fan running, which is incredibly satisfying.
Comments (English): [ This is a review after using it for a month. 1. First, it is really important to roughly clean up any food stuck on the dishes and soak them in water. If you don't do this, it won't be completely removed even after washing the dishes. 2. I'm a larva. ] || ---------------- || Here's a review after one month of use. 1. First, it's really important to roughly clean up any food particles on the dishes and soak them in water. If you don't do this, they won't be completely removed, even after being washed in the dishwasher. 2. I do pre-wash, but it's not a particularly laborious process. I just rinse the already-soaked dishes in clean water and put them back in. 3. It may be a matter of personal preference, but I'm impatient, so I use rapid mode. If you've done steps 1 and 2 well, rapid mode is sufficient. It removes most grease well. It only takes 5 minutes to clean the dishes, and after about 30 minutes of washing, you can hear the fan running, which is incredibly satisfying. 4. I air-dry. The hot air drying time (90 minutes) is too long. Even in rapid mode, the dishwasher uses hot water by default, so air-drying dries quickly. After rapid mode, the fan automatically turns on, but you can simply press the power button to stop it and leave the door open. 5. The spoon holder on the two-tier tray is really uncomfortable to use. This is something I hope Minix will improve. For now, I'm using a perforated stainless steel spoon holder from DaXso, and it's perfect. I recommend it. I got rid of the two-tier tray and am using more space. Most medium-sized pots fit. 6. I'm using half the Minix detergent. Unless you have dishes crammed in like in the commercial, this is enough. At first, I was annoyed by the white water stains left after washing the dishes, but after reducing the amount of detergent I used, there were hardly any water stains. My quality of life has really changed since I bought the Minix dishwasher. In the past, just thinking about washing dishes would stress me out and make my fingers hurt, but these days, I'm really happy. Thank you for making such a great product.

Sentence (English): I air-dry.
Comments (English): [ This is a review after using it for a month. 1. First, it is really important to roughly clean up any food stuck on the dishes and soak them in water. If you don't do this, it won't be completely removed even after washing the dishes. 2. I'm a larva. ] || ---------------- || Here's a review after one month of use. 1. First, it's really important to roughly clean up any food particles on the dishes and soak them in water. If you don't do this, they won't be completely removed, even after being washed in the dishwasher. 2. I do pre-wash, but it's not a particularly laborious process. I just rinse the already-soaked dishes in clean water and put them back in. 3. It may be a matter of personal preference, but I'm impatient, so I use rapid mode. If you've done steps 1 and 2 well, rapid mode is sufficient. It removes most grease well. It only takes 5 minutes to clean the dishes, and after about 30 minutes of washing, you can hear the fan running, which is incredibly satisfying. 4. I air-dry. The hot air drying time (90 minutes) is too long. Even in rapid mode, the dishwasher uses hot water by default, so air-drying dries quickly. After rapid mode, the fan automatically turns on, but you can simply press the power button to stop it and leave the door open. 5. The spoon holder on the two-tier tray is really uncomfortable to use. This is something I hope Minix will improve. For now, I'm using a perforated stainless steel spoon holder from DaXso, and it's perfect. I recommend it. I got rid of the two-tier tray and am using more space. Most medium-sized pots fit. 6. I'm using half the Minix detergent. Unless you have dishes crammed in like in the commercial, this is enough. At first, I was annoyed by the white water stains left after washing the dishes, but after reducing the amount of detergent I used, there were hardly any water stains. My quality of life has really changed since I bought the Minix dishwasher. In the past, just thinking about washing dishes would stress me out and make my fingers hurt, but these days, I'm really happy. Thank you for making such a great product.

Sentence (English): I don't know why I hate doing the dishes so much.
Comments (English): [ I like it! ] || ---------------- || I don't know why I hate doing the dishes so much. I can't just go without using the utensils and dishes, and it's hard to even call it washing while cooking. After eating, I just don't want to do anything, but this is so great! I used to think a dishwasher was a waste of money since I could do it myself, but now I honestly understand why people buy them! Maybe it's because I'm so lazy, but I'm just so happy! I thought doing the dishes by hand was more economical, but I heard dishwashers help save water too~ I'm just going to trust them and let them do it. Still, since it's not a human, things that get mushy and stuck to the spatula after making an omelet don't come off easily; they remain in small spots. You have to scrub those hard with a steel wool pad! Other than that, it seems to clean well! Just make sure to stack them neatly so they don't overlap! It can be stacked in two tiers, but if the first tier is packed with dishes, the ones on the second don't seem to get washed very well. Also, since I want to be able to thoroughly wash things like frying pans and pots, I just remove the second tier and load fewer items. It also has an automatic door opening function, so drying seems a bit easier! I've been using it for almost three months, and aside from the one time I put in a frying pan used to cook fish and ended up with a fishy smell, I'm generally satisfied! I compared it with other mid-sized dishwashers that seemed to offer good value for money and bought this one, and I think I made a good purchase! - Pros: - Superior value for money compared to major brand products. - The capacity is adequate, so you can wash pots and frying pans if you adjust the amount of dishes. - Cleaning power seems relatively good; it removes dirt well unless something is completely stuck on. - It is said to be water-saving. It seems more economical than expected. - Cons: - It doesn't remove heavily stuck-on food. - I wish the capacity were larger, but I consider that asking too much. It is the perfect size for my kitchen. - Repurchase Intention: I wonder if I would ever buy the same dishwasher again, but even if I went back in time, I think I would still buy it! It feels like it's been a few months since I got it. Maybe because I trusted the dishwasher so much, I put dishes with food stains in without rinsing them first, and they didn't seem to clean well, so these days I use it after pre-rinsing! I know I'm supposed to do that all along, but I'm only doing it now! To clean them more thoroughly, I added the soak function and am using the powerful wash~ I'm still just satisfied! Oh, but while pots seem to clean well, food seems to stick to the frying pans after running them in it, perhaps due to damage, so I'm washing them separately. It's nice having the dishwasher to lighten my workload, but I guess I'll still have to take care of the frying pans.

Sentence (English): We purchased this to replace a 15-year-old Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Works Well, some features disappointing ] || ---------------- || We purchased this to replace a 15-year-old Bosch dishwasher. It is much quieter, easy to use once you get the hang of the settings buttons, and cleans dishes well. I wish the racks and accessories were as heavy-duty and functional as those that came with the old unit. We like the 3rd top rack for utensils, especially as the lower rack's utensil basket is about 1/2 the size of the old one, so we rarely use it. The adjustable 2nd rack is helpful but does not accommodate our normal size wine glasses well. While there are slots for 6 wine glasses (the old one had 8 entirely useable slots) they are too close together so only 4 can be used at a time so it accommodates half as many as the old unit. Also, the areas behind and next to the wine glasses cannot be used for anything else without endangering the wine glasses. Our washer broke 3 of them the first week, so we decided to no longer put anything else on that side of the 2nd rack—and bought cheaper but stronger glasses. We now wash our finer wine glasses by hand.

I had a previous dishwasher which was about 14 yrs. old before I saw rust. I have tried to be in touch with Kitchen Aid/ Whirlpool for the past week, with their 800 number which keeps you on the phone at least 20-30 min before getting an agent and then a 3rd transfer to another dept. whose extension doesn't work. Finally got someone today to notice a similar problem in Oct. 2023 and possibly resolved it by telling them to buy a stainless steel cleaner . No idea if it works, but Kitchen Aid definitely knows about this and no mention is made to use a cleaner nor the Finish Jet Dry liquid to help with moisture. My sales rep ,whom I called today, is trying to get in touch with them to get some help, but so far this is the best I've gotten. Do NOT BUY this product. Service is terrible and I have no idea if I would have gotten better service IF I had bought a warranty- since their solution after over 3 hours of trying to get through is a cleaner .

Sentence (English): I could not believe how quiet this thing is in operation.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher, Very Quiet ] || ---------------- || I could not believe how quiet this thing is in operation. You really do need the indicator light to tell if it is running sometimes. With my old dishwasher (not a bosch) I basically had to prewash everything or it came out dirty. I no longer have to worry, they go in dirty and come out clean every time. I've found that it doesn't get everything dry, usually plastic things (hence the 4/5 stars) but if I prop the door open, things finish air drying just fine. It would be nice if there was a built-in prop for that purpose, but a wooden spoon does the job fine. Having the app notification so I know when the cycle is complete is helpful for that. I wish that all features were available on the built-in controls. Having the indicator light to show the cycle is running is great but an indicator that the cycle is complete would also be a nice feature. Better drying or a build in prop for the door, I've been using a wooden spoon but recently found some 3d printed ones that will attach to the upper basket I may try out. Overall, I would recommend this as a great dishwasher. It cleans everything I've thrown at it and is extremely quiet.

Sentence (English): The Bosch SMU6HCS01A dishwasher has transformed my kitchen routine with its exceptional performance and thoughtful design.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher, value for money ] || ---------------- || The Bosch SMU6HCS01A dishwasher has transformed my kitchen routine with its exceptional performance and thoughtful design. After using it for several months, I'm impressed by how quietly it operates - you can barely tell it's running, which is perfect for our open-plan living space. The flexible loading system accommodates everything from delicate glassware to large pots with ease. I particularly appreciate the adjustable upper rack that allows me to fit taller items below when needed. The cutlery drawer at the top is a game-changer compared to the traditional basket - it provides better cleaning results and maximizes space for dishes. On the performance front, dishes consistently come out spotless, even with stubborn, dried-on food. The Auto program intelligently adjusts water usage and temperature based on load size and soil level, saving both water and energy. The ExtraDry option has been particularly useful for plastics that typically retain moisture. The Home Connect feature allows me to monitor cycles remotely and receive notifications when the dishwasher needs attention, though I found the initial setup slightly challenging. While it's on the premium end price-wise, the energy and water efficiency, combined with superior cleaning performance, make it a worthwhile long-term investment. My only minor complaint is that the control panel markings could be more visible in low light. Overall, this Bosch dishwasher delivers exceptional cleaning performance with minimal noise and maximum efficiency - exactly what I was looking for in a premium appliance.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

My Samsung struggled with drying, even with Smart Dry, often leaving plastics wet. The Bosch 800's CrystalDry actually gets everything bone dry, which is a huge improvement. Cleaning performance is another big difference. StormWash on my Samsung was hit-or-miss, sometimes leaving residue. The Bosch consistently delivers spotless results, even without pre-rinsing. Overall, after my Samsung failed so quickly, I didn't want to take another chance. The Bosch 800 Series has been a major upgrade in quality, drying, and reliability and definitely worth it. 5/5 stars!

Sentence (English): I bought the Samsung Electronics Bespoke 14-person dishwasher DW60DB710W01 and have been using it twice a day.
Comments (English): [ great ] || ---------------- || I bought the Samsung Electronics Bespoke 14-person dishwasher DW60DB710W01 and have been using it twice a day. I regretted why I postponed buying it earlier. It's great that I can enjoy this convenience with an investment of about 800,000 won! It has a 3-stage configuration that can wash pots, rice bowls, and spoons, and my fingers used to hurt every time I washed the cups, water bottles, and spoons that came out every day. Now I'm free. The washing machine and dishwasher are better at housework than I am! It can't be better than this because I can run two appliances at the same time and I can rest on the sofa. It has a large capacity for 14 people, so it can handle the dishes, pots, and cooking utensils used by a family of five all at once, and it was especially convenient because I could efficiently arrange dishes of various sizes thanks to the 3-stage height-adjustable shelf. It has a high-temperature sterilization function, so I could use clean dishes without worrying about residual bacteria after washing. It is especially recommended for those who are sensitive to hygiene as it can produce clean results even on dishes used to cook meat or fish. It supports low-noise mode so you can use it at night without any worries, which is quite satisfying for me who was worried about the noise of a typical dishwasher. It is especially suitable for home use as it can wash quietly even late at night or when the child is asleep. You can check the status of the dishwasher in real time and control it remotely through the SmartThings app by linking your smartphone and dishwasher. You can check the washing progress while you are out and even set additional rinsing if necessary. If you want to reduce the hassle and inconvenience of washing dishes by hand, this is a dishwasher that has an excellent design and performance.
Comments (Original): [ 좋아요 ] || ---------------- || 삼성전자 비스포크 14인용 식기세척기 DW60DB710W01 구입 후 하루 2번씩 사용중이다. 진작에 구입할걸 왜 여태까지 미루었는지 후회가 됐다.80만원 정도 투자에 이런 편리함을 누릴수 있으니, 참 좋다!3단 구성으로 냄비, 밥그릇, 수저 세척 가능하고 매일 나오는 컵, 물병, 수저 닦을때마다 손가락 아팠는데... 이제 해방이다.세탁기도,  식기 세척기도 나보다 더 집안일을 잘한다!동시에 2가지 가전을 돌리면서, 난 쇼파에서 쉬고 있으니 이보다 더 좋을수 없다.14인용 대용량으로, 다섯 식구가 하루 동안 사용한 그릇과 냄비, 조리도구까지 한 번에 해결할 수 있고, 특히 3단 높이 조절 선반 덕분에 다양한 크기의 식기를 효율적으로 배치할 수 있어 편리했다.고온 살균 기능을 제공해 세척 후 잔여 세균 걱정 없이 깨끗한 식기를 사용할 수 있었어... 특히 육류나 생선을 조리한 식기에서도 깔끔한 결과를 얻을 수 있어 위생에 민감한 분들에게 적극 추천한다.저소음 모드를 지원해 밤에도 부담 없이 사용할 수 있으며, 일반적인 식기세척기의 소음이 걱정되었던 저에게는 상당히 만족스러운 부분이다.특히 늦은 저녁이나 아이가 잠든 시간에도 조용한 세척이 가능해 가정에서 활용하기에 정말 적합하다.스마트폰과 식기세척기를 연동해서 스마트싱스 앱을 통해 식기세척기의 상태를 실시간으로 확인하고 원격으로 제어할 수 있다.  외출 중에도 세척 진행 상황을 체크하고 필요한 경우 헹굼 추가 설정까지 가능했구,손으로 설거지하는 귀찮음과 번거로움을 줄이고 싶다면 디자인부터 성능까지 훌륭한 식기세척기이다.

Sentence (English): How much can you expect a dishwasher to do?
Comments (English): [ Smart Dishwasher for the Win ] || ---------------- || How much can you expect a dishwasher to do? It's a fairly simple appliance. It's all in the name. It washes the dishes. Ideally, you'd like for a dishwasher to do a good job for more than a handful of years, too. Our last dishwasher gave up the ghost as a result of some questionable wiring. We didn't know, but when we fixed the problem, the appliance had already bought the farm, it just didn't tell us. Then one day, it failed and we were faced with buying a new dishwasher. It's like the old song says, you don't know what you've got until it's gone. We waited because we wanted to make sure that this latest dishwasher would last and would be all we needed it to be. I did some research and in the meantime, we washed our own dishes like scullery maids. I finally came up with the Bosch. I heard good things, our plumber heard good things (and had installed a few over the years) and I even asked my appliance repairman, but he said he no longer gave opinions, but then he looked around, nodded and winked, and then cleared his throat and left. I trust these folks, so we were sold. So, we purchased our new dishwasher. To my surprise, it didn't take long for us to become really fond of it. I especially like the fact that you can put an app on the old smartphone and use that app to program your favorite wash cycle (that you create yourself) and can remotely start the programs, too. There's everything to choose from. Eco-friendly options, sanitization for when you're cleaning up from raw meats like chicken or fish, heated dry so that you're not splashing water around the kitchen when you empty it, and even self-washing options! You can name these wash cycles and make them your favorites, too. We just love that. The Bosch is also really quiet which is a huge benefit to us since our bedroom is close to the kitchen (ideal for midnight snacks, not ideal for noisy appliances) so sound is a factor. The adjustable middle rack is nice, so we can fit tall glasses or stemmed wine glasses in there one time, but then we can adjust it so we can put the cutting boards and casserole dishes in the bottom the next time. We love the top rack for flatware and the odd utensil. The app even keeps count of how many packets of dishwasher detergent you have left, and when you need to add the blue fluid that keeps things from getting spotty. If you are thinking about getting a Bosch, especially in this modern wasteland of shoddy, poorly made appliances and mail-order generics, you can feel good about your hard-earned money going into an appliance that will not only last but is fine German engineering at its finest. Go Bosch and you're going to thank them and yourself. And you won't have to get a kink stooping over the sink scrubbing off Grandma's baked-on grease from the antique casserole dish. Go Bosch and your dishes will always be clean and you will be very happy. ANd if you're happy because of a dishwasher that works and works well, then you're happy for a great reason!

LG제품을 구매하시는게 맞습니다.  예전에 삼성 건조기 한번 써보고…그 뒤로는 절대 삼성제품 구매안합니다. 2. 식기세척기 종류와 가격대 식기세척기 라인업 엄청 다양하죠? 가격도 저렴이부터 시작해서 고가제품까지 다양합니다.  이것만 고민하시면 됩니다! 심플하게!!!  - 나는 모든 기능이 다 들어가 있는 풀옵션이 좋아! -> 가장 비싼 라인 제품 구매하세요! 매장에서 판매하는 최고가 라인 제품 구매 추천드립니다. - 나는 기본 기능과 열풍건조가 필요해. 가격대도 적당했으면 좋겠어! -> 지금 보고 계시는 이 제품 구매하시면 됩니다. - 나는 열풍건조 필요없고, 그냥 저렴한거 살래 -> 이 제품보다 조금 더 저렴한 도어오픈형 건조방식 제품이 있습니다. 그 제품 구매하세요!  3. 주의할점  걸레받이 10cm, 15cm 잘 보시고 구매하세요.  제품마다 잘 설명되어 있으니 그거 보시고 맞는걸로 구매하세요! 이 제품은 15cm 제품입니다. 4. 설치 후기 LG기사님이 설치 당일 배낭을 하나 메고 오십니다.  설치가 가능한지 일단 체크 하러 올라오시구요.  설치 가능하면 식기세척기 제품 가지고 올라오십니다. ^^  저희집은 다행히 기존에 LG식기세척기가 있어서, 10년이 넘은 제품을 쏙 뽑아내고, 새로운 식기세척기를 쏙 넣었습니다.  당연히 추가금은 없었습니다. ^^ 5. 사용후기(성능)  성능이야 뭐 말해뭐합니다.  좋습니다.  6인용 쓰다가 14인용 쓰니 신세계입니다!  진작에 살껄…ㅠㅠ….너무 좋아요!  *** 요약 ***  엘지가 더 비쌉니다. 써보면 알아요  이 제품이 열풍건조 되는 모델이고, 가성비 가장 좋습니다. 성능은 그냥 최고에요!  *** 끝 ***

LG appliances have never broken down since we bought them. LG is more expensive. Refrigerators, dishwashers, washing machines, and dryers are all more expensive for LG. If you compare the prices of Samsung and LG, you can't buy LG products. Samsung has the same functions but is much cheaper. If you consider price first, I recommend Samsung products. However, if you consider everything else, such as performance and design? You should buy LG products. I used a Samsung dryer once before and have never bought a Samsung product since. 2. Dishwasher types and price ranges Dishwasher lineups are so diverse, right? The prices range from cheap to expensive. Just think about this! You'll know when you use it. This product is a model that dries with hot air and has the best cost-effectiveness. The performance is just the best! *** End ***

Sentence (English): Long story short, this machine washes and dries dirty dishes quietly and leaves dishes cleaner than if I had hand washed and dried them.
Comments (English): [ Worth the price ] || ---------------- || Long story short, this machine washes and dries dirty dishes quietly and leaves dishes cleaner than if I had hand washed and dried them. Short story long: This machine was not cheap by any means, but I think I got what I paid for. It has a huge list of features and options that I (and I suspect most people) will not use. But if you want to just sanitize your dishes using a specific amount of water then sure, you have that option. Or if you want to clean dishes harder in the back of the dishwasher than the front for some reason, go nuts. For most of us, we want to throw a cheese crusted plate into the dishwasher without rinsing it and remove a clean plate a short time later. This machine does that. It does that very well. I have incredibly hard water where I live but this thing has a built in water softener and because of that it cleans dishes better than I can do it manually. Also, if you use IoT type stuff, you can tell your robot of choice to "run the dishwasher" and it will. I set it to auto because as I mentioned, I don't need or want to fiddle with a lot of options to clean my dishes. It dries dishes very well also, and it does this without a heating element so it is safe to put your plastic dishes on the bottom rack which is extremely nice. Layout in general is good. I only have a couple of gripes. First, the sprayers tend to flip lighter plastic dishes upright so that they fill with water and of course don't dry. I'm sure some of this is user error and there is probably a way to place them so they dont do that. I still have and need a drying rack so its not a big deal but its worth mentioning. Second, plastic dishes in general won't dry because the door stays closed after drying. I have read that the 300 and 500 series will pop the door open after the cycle is complete to air dry the dishes. I love the element-less drying but why can't we have both with the 800? Thats basically it for complaints. Overall, its a great machine. Quiet too, you can barely tell its on while its running.

Sentence (English): It has been five years since we started our newlywed life.
Comments (English): [ Stylish design and convenient features ] || ---------------- || It has been five years since we started our newlywed life. I felt sorry for my husband, who always works so hard on the dishes, and I realized that it actually takes much more time than I thought. I wondered how much our quality of life would improve if we did other things with that time, especially after having a baby recently. It’s not just bottles; since we started introducing solid foods, there are bottles and tableware to deal with. Plus, the baby holds onto my legs, so I can't do the dishes in peace. I can't do them during naps for fear of waking the baby, and if I try to do them after my husband gets home from work, there is no time for the three of us to spend together. I feel bad asking my husband to do the dishes when he gets home, but doing it myself? I don't have the energy or the time. Since we are renting, I thought a built-in unit would be difficult, so I bought a countertop. I was worried it might not be enough because everyone else seems to have at least a 12-place setting, but my friends told me that for a three-person household, even if you have a larger unit, you mostly just use the top section anyway. Another thing that bothered me was the need for drilling, but after looking at online reviews, I found that this product could be installed without drilling after consulting with the technician, so I decided to give it a try. The day before the installation, the Samsung technician contacted me, and we discussed the installation environment in advance. Fortunately, they said they could route the wires along the baseboard just like they did with the water purifier, so the installation went smoothly the next day! I hesitated for months because of the high price and the worry that it wouldn't be drill-free. I don't know why I worried at all; it's truly heaven. I can run the dishwasher while I play with the baby and clean the living room. I'm so happy. Don't hesitate, just buy it! It's a waste of time to think about it! I'm also very satisfied with the features; it removes kimchi juice and grease stains completely. If I feel a bit uneasy, I just put in two packets of detergent and run it on the powerful mode. Since I have a baby, I also make good use of the bottle sterilization mode. The 6-place setting model doesn't have Smart Thinking, though; that's a bit of a shame.
Comments (Original): [ 세련된 디자인과 편리한 기능 ] || ---------------- || 신혼생활 후 5년이 지났습니다. 매번 설거지를 열심히 하는 남편도 불쌍하고 ㅠㅠ 생각보다 설거지에 소요되는 시간이 많더라구요?? 그 시간에 다른걸 하면 얼마나 삶의 질이 향상될까 싶었어요 ㅋㅋ 특히 요새 아기를 낳고 보니.. 젖병도 젖병인데 이유식을 하니 젖병에 식기류까지... 그리고 아기가 다리를 붙잡고 있어서맘편히 설거지도 못하고 낮잠잘때는 깰까봐 못하고, 남편이 퇴근한 뒤에 하려면 셋이 보낼 시간이 없더라구요. 퇴근하고 온 남편 설거지 시키기도 미안하고, 그렇다고 제가하기에는?? 체력과 시간이 없고 ㅋㅋ 전세라서 빌트인은 어려울것같아서 카운터탑을 샀어요. 다들 12인용 이상을 기본적으로 구비하길래 모자랄까봐 걱정했는데, 친구들이 어차피 3인가구는 12인용 이상이 있어도 상단부분만 많이 쓴다고 하더라구요. 또 맘에 걸린점이 타공을 해야한다는 부분이었는데, 인터넷 후기를 찾아보니 기사님과 상의 후에 무타공으로 진행도 가능한 제품이길래 도전해봤습니다. 설치 전날 삼성기사님 연락이 오셨고, 설치환경에 대해서 미리 논의했어요. 다행히 정수기를 설치한 것과 같이 걸레받이 쪽으로 선을 빼서 해주실 수 있을 것 같다고 하셔서 다음날 무사히 설치했습니다!가격도 비싸고 무타공을 안될까봐 몇달 고민했는데... 왜 고민했나 모르겠습니다 진짜 천국입니다... 식세기 돌려놓고 저는 아기랑 놀아주고, 거실 치우고.. 행복합니다 ㅠㅠ 망설이지말고 구매하세요! 고민하는 시간아까워요! 그리고 기능도 넘 만족해요, 김치국물, 기름자국 싹 다 지워집니다. 좀 찝찝할때는 세제 2개 넣고 강력모드로 돌리면돼요 ㅎㅎㅎ 아기도 있어서 젖병살균모드도 잘 쓰고있습니다.6인용은 스마트띵킹은 안되더라구요 요게 조금 아쉽네요

Comments (English): [ Quiet & Effective ] || ---------------- || Have been using the unit for a month and I have used the recommended detergent packets and rinse products they recommend and all together it cleans everything. He was absolutely right - everything comes out completely clean including utensils on the third rach with peanut butter and cream cheese remnants. Couple this with a an extremely quiet sound level and an app that lets you control different features and this is a winner. Sentence (English): This is our first Bosch appliance.
Comments (English): [ Bosh 300 Series Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is our first Bosch appliance. After comparing multiple brands it was obvious that this Bosch dishwasher best fit our needs. We were immediately impressed with the unit. We had not noticed the silverware rack when evaluating the photos on line. It has been a most pleasant addition. We love the way it organizes the silverware and is at the top of the machine, most other brands are in a basket at the bottom of the machine. The machines appearance is very pleasing for us and fits our kitchen perfectly. The machine performs perfectly in all modes. The dishes are washed sparkle clean and the drying feature is excellent. The machine is perfectly quiet when functioning. If you are considering purchasing a new dishwasher this is the machine for you. We could not more highly recommend it. We called customer during the initial setup and the technician was excellent and would not conclude our session until she was convinced that our situation was resolved and all questions answered. This is the way customer service is suppose to happen. A difficult thing to find with most companies these days. We could not be more satisfied with the product and with Bosch. Thank you

Comments (English): [ Arrived Broken. 3 Weeks to fix. ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher arrived and upon unpacking we found you can't hook this up to a standard household waterline. Checked the tray and it was dry, attempted to reset the breaker no change, inug the float switch and no change. Called whirlpool and it would be 4. Days before a technician could come out, not great but should be an easy fix, pop off the old broke switch and put a new one on. The technician arrived and after 5 minutes and a few checks agrees with me that it's either a broken.float switch or a fault in the wiring harness. He brought neither and said he would have to order them, this was the WHIRLPOOL TECHNICIAN, and they wouldn't be in for another week. So here we are 3 weeks into having our new machine and it still doesn't work as we await parts on a BRAND. NEW. DISHWASHER.

I was told that the 800 series had a feature called crystal dry and it would dry everything (even most plastics) in the cycle if you had that feature selected. Comments (English): [ Could be better ] || ---------------- || Bought this as a Clearance item last year to replace a 15 year old GE profile, so I guess this would be "last years model". I don't think there is a cycle under 2 hours. I don't use the app for this, I just want to push start and let it run. Sometimes it doesn't seem to clean as well as the old one. NEVER dries completely even on extra dry, night dry or high temp. Especially plastics. Our old DW got Hot and was dry when opened. Also, this DW seems to almost always have an odor after washing and left over food particles sit on the bottom of the DW filter screen. I don't know if it is a LG design fault or Gov. regulations for energy saving features, but what ever it is it needs to change. I will not buy another LG when this is done. I have a set of LG front load washer and dryer that's 13 years old and love them. However I can't see this DW lasting that long.

Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher ] || ---------------- || After 15 years my Whirlpool just gave it up. I have talked to several of my friends that have Bosch dishwashers and they all said even if you get the most stripped down model it's still a great dishwasher. So I bought the floor model and got a little off there and I think there was one other little discount for about $100 all together. I installed it and I could not be happier. It's not as quiet as my neighbors top of the line Bosch but I really don't care. It's still quieter than my Whirlpool was. The first thing I noticed was that all of my silverware was remarkably shinier and cleaner. I also like the fact that there is no heating element for the dry cycle, all the less electricity used! All in all I would definitely recommend even the 300 model. If I could change one thing about this dishwasher I would make it have a row of vertical pins on the bottom dish rack so I could put water bottles onto it straight up and down. Even though they're on an angle they always come out clean however. Would highly recommend even the 300 level

Comments (English): [ I replaced the dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || Hello, I used to use a 6-person SK from another company, but I wanted to buy a built-in one because of the splitting issue, so I looked into it and chose Samsung! The reason I personally didn't like the drying function of LG, which is famous for its dishwashers, is because I thought the dishes wouldn't be able to withstand that temperature. No matter how good the machine performance is, dishes are easily damaged by high temperatures! So I looked for a suitable function, and I was very satisfied with the 55-minute course that only has the essential door-opening function and I like short courses. I was worried that the existing sink was higher than average and that it would cost a lot to make the cabinet, but fortunately, there were no additional costs other than 30,000 won. Also, since my house is a wood tone, this color goes very well with me, so I'm satisfied. Cleaning power 4 stars Compared to the existing SK 6-person, this one cleans better, but does it really clean 100% dramatically? I guess it's still the limit of technology! In addition, even if you dry it with hot air, the moisture remains. Installation stars 3 I installed it under the gas range. Hmm. A lot of hot heat goes to the gas battery. There is no safety issue. There is a 1% chance that it could happen to my house. I am personally very, very worried. The disadvantage of built-in is that the lower cabinet is full of moisture. I didn't know, but it's because the inside is all perforated. I think the lower cabinet will be damaged after using it for about 10 years. It is disappointing in many ways. Even though it is a two-person household, on days when several large pots come out, it is not enough even though it is a large capacity. When I usually use a 6-person one, I used it twice, so I think this size is necessary even for 2 people! Don't buy a small one just because you are a two-person household! It is a great deal! Oh, right, what I am really, really, really satisfied with is the noise. I didn't think the previous one was noisy. Wow, is this what you are using and running? It is so quiet that it is no problem even if you run it late at night! It is described intuitively, but the price is actually very cheap. I recommend a large capacity for the price of a 6-person one! I will use the rinse when it comes and leave another review!

Sentence (English): I've been married for 17 years and I'm a housewife.
Comments (English): [ My first time using a dishwasher~ ] || ---------------- || I've been married for 17 years and I'm a housewife. I'm a family of 4 and I eat breakfast before going to work and school. Of course I eat soup too. After 4 people eat, there's more dishwashing than you'd think. Most of the side dishes are on individual plates. Since both of us work, I always washed the dishes in the morning and went to work. I think it took about 20 minutes. But I bought a dishwasher for the first time since I moved and I'm using it. It's for 14 people, so I soak it in water in the morning and turn it on after dinner. It's good because it can hold a lot of food, including a rice cooker and frying pan. I think I made a good decision to buy a big one. At first, it was hard because I didn't know what was what, but now I think I'm used to it. I'm satisfied with everything, but there's one thing I regret. I don't know if I can't find it, but there's no place to check the rinse aid notification. So I just put the amount in once when I use it. Other than that, I like it. It's also very quiet, so it doesn't bother me at all. The color goes well with our sink. I'm so happy because I don't have to wash the dishes these days. I put it back in the evening and went to work out~ I was worried a lot about the 12-person size, but I think the bigger the dishwasher, the better. There isn't much of a difference in size. I think they're similar. If there's anyone who's worried, I recommend the 14-person size.
Comments (Original): [ 처음 사용하는 식세기~ ] || ---------------- || 저는 결혼 17년차 주부에요.  4인가족이고 아침을 다 먹고 출근. 등교해요.  국도 당연히 먹고요. 4인이 먹고나면 설거지 생각보다 많아요.  반찬도 대부분 개인접시 사용하거든요.  맞벌이여서 아침에 설거지를 항상 하고 출근했는데요.  20분정도 소요 됐던거 같아요.  그런데 이사오고 식세기 처음으로 구매해서 사용중이에요.  14인용이어서 아침에는 물에 불려놓고 저녁 먹고 같이 한번에 돌리고 있어요.  양이 많아도 밥솥 후라이팬 다 들어가서 좋아요.  큰거사길 잘한거 같아요.  처음에는 뭐가 뭔지 몰라서 어려웠는데 지금은 적응 된거 같아요.  다 만족하는데 한가지 아쉬운게 있어요.  제가 못찾는건지 린스 알림을 확인하는곳이 없어요.ㅠ 그래서 저는 그냥 사용할때 한번정도 사용량 넣고 쓰고있어요  그거 말고는 좋아요.  엄청 조용하기도 해서 전혀 방해되지 않아요  색상도 저희 싱그대와 잘어울려요  요즘 설거지 안해서 너무 좋아요.  저녁에 돌려 놓고 운동가고 있어요~  12인용이랑 고민 많이 했는데 식세기 클수록 좋은거 같아요  사이즈도 별차이 안나요.  비슷했던거 같아요  고민중이신분들 계시면 14인용 추천합니다.

1) 출시년도 : 모델 출시년도가 24년 초로 최신~ 2) 소음 유무 : 너무~~~ 조용해요~ ㅎㅎ 3) 설거지 세척 정도 : 이 점이 가장 중요하죠 ㅎ 정말 완전 최강 깨끗, 깔끔, 시원~ ㅎㅎ 4) 가격 : 백화점이나 오프매장에 비해 아주 좋음 ㅎ (설치 기사님도 제품 모델넘버 확인 후 쿠팡으로 주문한다고ㅋ) 5) 용량 : 14인용으로 (3~5인용 가구원) 무엇보다 용량 큰 거로 6) 진동 유무 : 저의 없음 7) 원격진단, 원격제어 유무 : 가능 (업그레이드 싱큐앱으로~) 8) 건조 가능 : 열풍 건조로 아주 기능 굿~ 9) 3단으로 맨 위는 숟가락, 젓가락, 국자, 위생가위 기타 등등 10 )코스 선택 다양 11) 음성 안내 : 소모품 교체시기, 위생관리 알림, 에러 원인 알림 12) 자동문 열림 기능 : 굿~ 13) 연수장치 : 소금 넣은~ 얼룩이나 물비린내 또는 잡내 없음~ 14) 스팀 기능 : 굿~ 15) 살균, 건조로 기름때까지 깔끔 (식세기 넣기 전에 물로 한 번 애벌 세척 후 넣어 줘요) 16) 식세기 내부 망에 음식물 찌꺼기 청소도 바로바로 해줌 17) 디자인 깔끔~ 퀄리티 굿~ (주방 싱크대에 잘 어울려요 고급스러워요 ㅋ) 18) 조작법 : 직관적이고 쉽고 간편함~ 19) 무엇보다 호불호가 없음! 무조건 호!!! 20) 식세기 싱큐앱으로 업그레이드 굿~ ⭕️ 단점이나 아쉬운 점은?? 1) 크게 아쉬운 점은 없음~ 2) 단점은 아닌 매번 올인원 타블렛 세재 구입 별도로 해야 함~ 3) 어떤 때는 식세기 안에 설거지 가득 그릇 넣는 게 귀찮음, 애벌로 물로 한 번 헹구는 것도 귀찮음 ㅋㅋ (사람이란 참~ 간사하죠 ㅋㅋ) 4) 그 외엔 없어요~ ⭕️ 이 식세기 추천? 완전 최강 초강추합니다^^ 가격대가 높지만~ 집에 이모님이 오십니다 ㅋㅋ 식세기 뮐 사야 고민될 때! 이 모델로~ ㅋ 열풍건조 있는 모델로 ㅋ 역시 가전은? 쿠팡 로켓설치는 정말 시간 절약에 최적화인 듯! 주문 후 설치 기사님 콜 오고 날짜, 시간 확인 후 전에 세탁기는 2명이 오셨는데, 식세기에는 1명이 오심~ (아주 친절~ 초스피드 설치, 사용방법 설명) 이런 순번 ㅋ 주변 정리도 깔끔히 해 줌~ (별거 아니지만 구론X 한 병 드리니~ 너무 좋아하심) 쿠팡 특가도 좋은 점이 가격도 내려가지만~ 로켓설치로 원하는 일자 조율해서 기사님들 오셔서 설치 유무 확인 후~ 바로 쓱싹쓱싹 설치 (주문 전에 식세기 주방 설치 유무 확인 후 주문하시라고~ 싱크대 가스레인지 밑에 보통 설치하니~ 밑에 길이인가 확인 하시던 거 같은데 ㅎ 전화로 물어보심 ㅋ) 설치 기사님 한 분이 오셔서 폭풍 설치 후~^^ 정말 신기방기 ㅋ 그런데 식세기 설치 후 필요한 게 많네요... 전용으로 용량 맞는 소금도 필요하고, 식세기 전용 타블렛 올인원으로 캔디처럼 생긴 고형 세재(?)가 필요해요^^ 기사님 설치해 주시고 바로 올인원으로 구매하시라고 강력히 얘기해 주심~ ⭕️ 식기세척기 좋은 점?? 1) 출시년도 : 모델 출시년도가 24년 초로 최신~ 2) 소음 유무 : 너무~~~ 조용해요~ ㅎㅎ 3) 설거지 세척 정도 : 이 점이 가장 중요하죠 ㅎ 정말 완전 최강 깨끗, 깔끔, 시원~ ㅎㅎ 4) 가격 : 백화점이나 오프매장에 비해 아주 좋음 ㅎ (설치 기사님도 제품 모델넘버 확인 후 쿠팡으로 주문한다고ㅋ) 5) 용량 : 14인용으로 (3~5인용 가구원) 무엇보다 용량 큰 거로 6) 진동 유무 : 저의 없음 7) 원격진단, 원격제어 유무 : 가능 (업그레이드 싱큐앱으로~) 8) 건조 가능 : 열풍 건조로 아주 기능 굿~ 9) 3단으로 맨 위는 숟가락, 젓가락, 국자, 위생가위 기타 등등 10 )코스 선택 다양 11) 음성 안내 : 소모품 교체시기, 위생관리 알림, 에러 원인 알림 12) 자동문 열림 기능 : 굿~ 13) 연수장치 : 소금 넣은~ 얼룩이나 물비린내 또는 잡내 없음~ 14) 스팀 기능 : 굿~ 15) 살균, 건조로 기름때까지 깔끔 (식세기 넣기 전에 물로 한 번 애벌 세척 후 넣어 줘요) 16) 식세기 내부 망에 음식물 찌꺼기 청소도 바로바로 해줌 17) 디자인 깔끔~ 퀄리티 굿~ (주방 싱크대에 잘 어울려요 고급스러워요 ㅋ) 18) 조작법 : 직관적이고 쉽고 간편함~ 19) 무엇보다 호불호가 없음! 무조건 호!!! 20) 식세기 싱큐앱으로 업그레이드 굿~ ⭕️ 단점이나 아쉬운 점은?? 1) 크게 아쉬운 점은 없음~ 2) 단점은 아닌 매번 올인원 타블렛 세재 구입 별도로 해야 함~ 3) 어떤 때는 식세기 안에 설거지 가득 그릇 넣는 게 귀찮음, 애벌로 물로 한 번 헹구는 것도 귀찮음 ㅋㅋ (사람이란 참~ 간사하죠 ㅋㅋ) 4) 그 외엔 없어요~ ⭕️ 이 식세기 추천? 완전 최강 초강추합니다^^ 가격대가 높지만~ 집에 이모님이 오십니다 ㅋㅋ 식세기 뮐 사야 고민될 때! 이 모델로~ ㅋ 열풍건조 있는 모델로 ㅋ 역시 가전은? 엘쥐죠 LG ㅋ 제 리뷰 보시고 조금이나마 참고하셨으면 좋겠습니다^^ 특가 나오면 더 굿~ ⭕️ 여긴 안 보셔도 돼요~ 아이가 2명에 4식구에 거의 저녁은 집에서 해요 ㅜㅜ 은근 설거지가 산더미로 ㅋ 다들 아시죠 ㅋ 요즘은 식세기도 절대 필수 주방 아이템이고~ 라떼라는 말... 요즘 세상은 정말 편리해요 ㅋ 좋습니다^^ 식세기 돌아가는 자투리 시간 아이들 놀아주거나 공부 봐주고.. 잠깐의 여유가 큰 삶의 원동력이 되네요 ㅎ 이상 잡소리였습니다~ ⭕️ 끝인사~ 솔직한 후기로 1분기 넘게 사용한 리뷰입니다^^ 긴 글 여기까지 읽어 주셔서 너무 감사드리고~ 오늘도 건강하고 스트레스 조금만 받는 하루 보내세요 마지막으로  '도움이 돼요도' 살짝 눌러주시면 너무나 큰 힘이 되겠습니다.

쿠팡 로켓설치는 정말 시간 절약에 최적화인 듯! 주문 후 설치 기사님 콜 오고 날짜, 시간 확인 후 전에 세탁기는 2명이 오셨는데, 식세기에는 1명이 오심~ (아주 친절~ 초스피드 설치, 사용방법 설명) 이런 순번 ㅋ 주변 정리도 깔끔히 해 줌~ (별거 아니지만 구론X 한 병 드리니~ 너무 좋아하심) 쿠팡 특가도 좋은 점이 가격도 내려가지만~ 로켓설치로 원하는 일자 조율해서 기사님들 오셔서 설치 유무 확인 후~ 바로 쓱싹쓱싹 설치 (주문 전에 식세기 주방 설치 유무 확인 후 주문하시라고~ 싱크대 가스레인지 밑에 보통 설치하니~ 밑에 길이인가 확인 하시던 거 같은데 ㅎ 전화로 물어보심 ㅋ) 설치 기사님 한 분이 오셔서 폭풍 설치 후~^^ 정말 신기방기 ㅋ 그런데 식세기 설치 후 필요한 게 많네요... 전용으로 용량 맞는 소금도 필요하고, 식세기 전용 타블렛 올인원으로 캔디처럼 생긴 고형 세재(?)가 필요해요^^ 기사님 설치해 주시고 바로 올인원으로 구매하시라고 강력히 얘기해 주심~ ⭕️ 식기세척기 좋은 점?? 1) 출시년도 : 모델 출시년도가 24년 초로 최신~ 2) 소음 유무 : 너무~~~ 조용해요~ ㅎㅎ 3) 설거지 세척 정도 : 이 점이 가장 중요하죠 ㅎ 정말 완전 최강 깨끗, 깔끔, 시원~ ㅎㅎ 4) 가격 : 백화점이나 오프매장에 비해 아주 좋음 ㅎ (설치 기사님도 제품 모델넘버 확인 후 쿠팡으로 주문한다고ㅋ) 5) 용량 : 14인용으로 (3~5인용 가구원) 무엇보다 용량 큰 거로 6) 진동 유무 : 저의 없음 7) 원격진단, 원격제어 유무 : 가능 (업그레이드 싱큐앱으로~) 8) 건조 가능 : 열풍 건조로 아주 기능 굿~ 9) 3단으로 맨 위는 숟가락, 젓가락, 국자, 위생가위 기타 등등 10 )코스 선택 다양 11) 음성 안내 : 소모품 교체시기, 위생관리 알림, 에러 원인 알림 12) 자동문 열림 기능 : 굿~ 13) 연수장치 : 소금 넣은~ 얼룩이나 물비린내 또는 잡내 없음~ 14) 스팀 기능 : 굿~ 15) 살균, 건조로 기름때까지 깔끔 (식세기 넣기 전에 물로 한 번 애벌 세척 후 넣어 줘요) 16) 식세기 내부 망에 음식물 찌꺼기 청소도 바로바로 해줌 17) 디자인 깔끔~ 퀄리티 굿~ (주방 싱크대에 잘 어울려요 고급스러워요 ㅋ) 18) 조작법 : 직관적이고 쉽고 간편함~ 19) 무엇보다 호불호가 없음! 무조건 호!!! 20) 식세기 싱큐앱으로 업그레이드 굿~ ⭕️ 단점이나 아쉬운 점은?? 1) 크게 아쉬운 점은 없음~ 2) 단점은 아닌 매번 올인원 타블렛 세재 구입 별도로 해야 함~ 3) 어떤 때는 식세기 안에 설거지 가득 그릇 넣는 게 귀찮음, 애벌로 물로 한 번 헹구는 것도 귀찮음 ㅋㅋ (사람이란 참~ 간사하죠 ㅋㅋ) 4) 그 외엔 없어요~ ⭕️ 이 식세기 추천? 완전 최강 초강추합니다^^ 가격대가 높지만~ 집에 이모님이 오십니다 ㅋㅋ 식세기 뮐 사야 고민될 때! 이 모델로~ ㅋ 열풍건조 있는 모델로 ㅋ 역시 가전은? 엘쥐죠 LG ㅋ 제 리뷰 보시고 조금이나마 참고하셨으면 좋겠습니다^^ 특가 나오면 더 굿~ ⭕️ 여긴 안 보셔도 돼요~ 아이가 2명에 4식구에 거의 저녁은 집에서 해요 ㅜㅜ 은근 설거지가 산더미로 ㅋ 다들 아시죠 ㅋ 요즘은 식세기도 절대 필수 주방 아이템이고~ 라떼라는 말... 요즘 세상은 정말 편리해요 ㅋ 좋습니다^^ 식세기 돌아가는 자투리 시간 아이들 놀아주거나 공부 봐주고.. 잠깐의 여유가 큰 삶의 원동력이 되네요 ㅎ 이상 잡소리였습니다~ ⭕️ 끝인사~ 솔직한 후기로 1분기 넘게 사용한 리뷰입니다^^ 긴 글 여기까지 읽어 주셔서 너무 감사드리고~ 오늘도 건강하고 스트레스 조금만 받는 하루 보내세요 마지막으로  '도움이 돼요도' 살짝 눌러주시면 너무나 큰 힘이 되겠습니다.

쿠팡 로켓설치는 정말 시간 절약에 최적화인 듯! 주문 후 설치 기사님 콜 오고 날짜, 시간 확인 후 전에 세탁기는 2명이 오셨는데, 식세기에는 1명이 오심~ (아주 친절~ 초스피드 설치, 사용방법 설명) 이런 순번 ㅋ 주변 정리도 깔끔히 해 줌~ (별거 아니지만 구론X 한 병 드리니~ 너무 좋아하심) 쿠팡 특가도 좋은 점이 가격도 내려가지만~ 로켓설치로 원하는 일자 조율해서 기사님들 오셔서 설치 유무 확인 후~ 바로 쓱싹쓱싹 설치 (주문 전에 식세기 주방 설치 유무 확인 후 주문하시라고~ 싱크대 가스레인지 밑에 보통 설치하니~ 밑에 길이인가 확인 하시던 거 같은데 ㅎ 전화로 물어보심 ㅋ) 설치 기사님 한 분이 오셔서 폭풍 설치 후~^^ 정말 신기방기 ㅋ 그런데 식세기 설치 후 필요한 게 많네요... 전용으로 용량 맞는 소금도 필요하고, 식세기 전용 타블렛 올인원으로 캔디처럼 생긴 고형 세재(?)가 필요해요^^ 기사님 설치해 주시고 바로 올인원으로 구매하시라고 강력히 얘기해 주심~ ⭕️ 식기세척기 좋은 점?? 1) 출시년도 : 모델 출시년도가 24년 초로 최신~ 2) 소음 유무 : 너무~~~ 조용해요~ ㅎㅎ 3) 설거지 세척 정도 : 이 점이 가장 중요하죠 ㅎ 정말 완전 최강 깨끗, 깔끔, 시원~ ㅎㅎ 4) 가격 : 백화점이나 오프매장에 비해 아주 좋음 ㅎ (설치 기사님도 제품 모델넘버 확인 후 쿠팡으로 주문한다고ㅋ) 5) 용량 : 14인용으로 (3~5인용 가구원) 무엇보다 용량 큰 거로 6) 진동 유무 : 저의 없음 7) 원격진단, 원격제어 유무 : 가능 (업그레이드 싱큐앱으로~) 8) 건조 가능 : 열풍 건조로 아주 기능 굿~ 9) 3단으로 맨 위는 숟가락, 젓가락, 국자, 위생가위 기타 등등 10 )코스 선택 다양 11) 음성 안내 : 소모품 교체시기, 위생관리 알림, 에러 원인 알림 12) 자동문 열림 기능 : 굿~ 13) 연수장치 : 소금 넣은~ 얼룩이나 물비린내 또는 잡내 없음~ 14) 스팀 기능 : 굿~ 15) 살균, 건조로 기름때까지 깔끔 (식세기 넣기 전에 물로 한 번 애벌 세척 후 넣어 줘요) 16) 식세기 내부 망에 음식물 찌꺼기 청소도 바로바로 해줌 17) 디자인 깔끔~ 퀄리티 굿~ (주방 싱크대에 잘 어울려요 고급스러워요 ㅋ) 18) 조작법 : 직관적이고 쉽고 간편함~ 19) 무엇보다 호불호가 없음! 무조건 호!!! 20) 식세기 싱큐앱으로 업그레이드 굿~ ⭕️ 단점이나 아쉬운 점은?? 1) 크게 아쉬운 점은 없음~ 2) 단점은 아닌 매번 올인원 타블렛 세재 구입 별도로 해야 함~ 3) 어떤 때는 식세기 안에 설거지 가득 그릇 넣는 게 귀찮음, 애벌로 물로 한 번 헹구는 것도 귀찮음 ㅋㅋ (사람이란 참~ 간사하죠 ㅋㅋ) 4) 그 외엔 없어요~ ⭕️ 이 식세기 추천? 완전 최강 초강추합니다^^ 가격대가 높지만~ 집에 이모님이 오십니다 ㅋㅋ 식세기 뮐 사야 고민될 때! 이 모델로~ ㅋ 열풍건조 있는 모델로 ㅋ 역시 가전은? 쿠팡 로켓설치는 정말 시간 절약에 최적화인 듯! 주문 후 설치 기사님 콜 오고 날짜, 시간 확인 후 전에 세탁기는 2명이 오셨는데, 식세기에는 1명이 오심~ (아주 친절~ 초스피드 설치, 사용방법 설명) 이런 순번 ㅋ 주변 정리도 깔끔히 해 줌~ (별거 아니지만 구론X 한 병 드리니~ 너무 좋아하심) 쿠팡 특가도 좋은 점이 가격도 내려가지만~ 로켓설치로 원하는 일자 조율해서 기사님들 오셔서 설치 유무 확인 후~ 바로 쓱싹쓱싹 설치 (주문 전에 식세기 주방 설치 유무 확인 후 주문하시라고~ 싱크대 가스레인지 밑에 보통 설치하니~ 밑에 길이인가 확인 하시던 거 같은데 ㅎ 전화로 물어보심 ㅋ) 설치 기사님 한 분이 오셔서 폭풍 설치 후~^^ 정말 신기방기 ㅋ 그런데 식세기 설치 후 필요한 게 많네요... 전용으로 용량 맞는 소금도 필요하고, 식세기 전용 타블렛 올인원으로 캔디처럼 생긴 고형 세재(?)가 필요해요^^ 기사님 설치해 주시고 바로 올인원으로 구매하시라고 강력히 얘기해 주심~ ⭕️ 식기세척기 좋은 점?? 1) 출시년도 : 모델 출시년도가 24년 초로 최신~ 2) 소음 유무 : 너무~~~ 조용해요~ ㅎㅎ 3) 설거지 세척 정도 : 이 점이 가장 중요하죠 ㅎ 정말 완전 최강 깨끗, 깔끔, 시원~ ㅎㅎ 4) 가격 : 백화점이나 오프매장에 비해 아주 좋음 ㅎ (설치 기사님도 제품 모델넘버 확인 후 쿠팡으로 주문한다고ㅋ) 5) 용량 : 14인용으로 (3~5인용 가구원) 무엇보다 용량 큰 거로 6) 진동 유무 : 저의 없음 7) 원격진단, 원격제어 유무 : 가능 (업그레이드 싱큐앱으로~) 8) 건조 가능 : 열풍 건조로 아주 기능 굿~ 9) 3단으로 맨 위는 숟가락, 젓가락, 국자, 위생가위 기타 등등 10 )코스 선택 다양 11) 음성 안내 : 소모품 교체시기, 위생관리 알림, 에러 원인 알림 12) 자동문 열림 기능 : 굿~ 13) 연수장치 : 소금 넣은~ 얼룩이나 물비린내 또는 잡내 없음~ 14) 스팀 기능 : 굿~ 15) 살균, 건조로 기름때까지 깔끔 (식세기 넣기 전에 물로 한 번 애벌 세척 후 넣어 줘요) 16) 식세기 내부 망에 음식물 찌꺼기 청소도 바로바로 해줌 17) 디자인 깔끔~ 퀄리티 굿~ (주방 싱크대에 잘 어울려요 고급스러워요 ㅋ) 18) 조작법 : 직관적이고 쉽고 간편함~ 19) 무엇보다 호불호가 없음! 무조건 호!!! 20) 식세기 싱큐앱으로 업그레이드 굿~ ⭕️ 단점이나 아쉬운 점은?? 1) 크게 아쉬운 점은 없음~ 2) 단점은 아닌 매번 올인원 타블렛 세재 구입 별도로 해야 함~ 3) 어떤 때는 식세기 안에 설거지 가득 그릇 넣는 게 귀찮음, 애벌로 물로 한 번 헹구는 것도 귀찮음 ㅋㅋ (사람이란 참~ 간사하죠 ㅋㅋ) 4) 그 외엔 없어요~ ⭕️ 이 식세기 추천? 완전 최강 초강추합니다^^ 가격대가 높지만~ 집에 이모님이 오십니다 ㅋㅋ 식세기 뮐 사야 고민될 때! 이 모델로~ ㅋ 열풍건조 있는 모델로 ㅋ 역시 가전은? 엘쥐죠 LG ㅋ 제 리뷰 보시고 조금이나마 참고하셨으면 좋겠습니다^^ 특가 나오면 더 굿~ ⭕️ 여긴 안 보셔도 돼요~ 아이가 2명에 4식구에 거의 저녁은 집에서 해요 ㅜㅜ 은근 설거지가 산더미로 ㅋ 다들 아시죠 ㅋ 요즘은 식세기도 절대 필수 주방 아이템이고~ 라떼라는 말... 요즘 세상은 정말 편리해요 ㅋ 좋습니다^^ 식세기 돌아가는 자투리 시간 아이들 놀아주거나 공부 봐주고.. 잠깐의 여유가 큰 삶의 원동력이 되네요 ㅎ 이상 잡소리였습니다~ ⭕️ 끝인사~ 솔직한 후기로 1분기 넘게 사용한 리뷰입니다^^ 긴 글 여기까지 읽어 주셔서 너무 감사드리고~ 오늘도 건강하고 스트레스 조금만 받는 하루 보내세요 마지막으로  '도움이 돼요도' 살짝 눌러주시면 너무나 큰 힘이 되겠습니다.
